depth_to_organized_points — 3D range_image op

• Data kinds: depth → pointmap

• Call: import range_image; range_image.depth_to_organized_points(depth, fx=None, fy=None, cx=None, cy=None) (or ops3d.get("depth_to_organized_points"))

Usage

An organized depth image → grid-aligned 3-D points (H,W,3).
